subject: Information matrix estimation issue when the Model don't converge

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Information matrix estimation issue when the Model don't converge
parts:
Hi, Phil.

Can I turn off SE = T to SE = F automatically when a model do not converge? Sometimes my models don't converge, but the mirt does try to estimate the information matrix; That's time wasting in some situations.

Like this;

Stage 3 = 4000, LL = -37342.7, AR(4.00) = [0.25], gam = 0.0004, Max-Change = 0.0418
MHRM terminated after 4000 iterations.

Calculating information matrix...

Seongho
